thread.title: Close Update: Dow Surges Almost 1,100 Points as Market Shakes Off Pre-Christmas Despair

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Dow Surges Almost 1,100 Points as Market Shakes Off Pre-Christmas Despair
text:
Close Update: Dow Surges Almost 1,100 Points as Market Shakes Off Pre-Christmas Despair December 26, 2018, 04:49:25 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo
The Nasdaq Composite Index led the market's major indexes higher Wednesday, bouncing back after a dreadful Christmas Eve session, as the Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed almost 1,100 points.
Positive retail spending news helped send the market higher. Retail sales rose 5.1% in the holiday shopping season to $850 billion, the strongest growth in six years, according to Mastercard SpendingPulse. Shares of consumer discretionary companies in the S&P 500 rose more than 6% as a group and led the market on the upside. Online retailing giant Amazon.com ( AMZN ) jumped about 9.5%. The company said it had a record-breaking holiday shopping season.
Stocks were also boosted by comments from White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett, who said that he was confident President Donald Trump was pleased with the job Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin was doing and that Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell's job was safe, according to a NBC News report.
The Nasdaq jumped almost 6%, while the Dow and S&P 500 both gained about 5%. The Dow was led by Nike ( NKE ), Apple ( AAPL ) and Visa ( V ), which all climbed about 7% each.
Energy was also a big winner Wednesday as the price of crude oil jumped. Late in the afternoon, West Texas Intermediate crude for February delivery was up almost 10% to $46.77 a barrel.
